newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai unit enters service agreements.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai unit enters service agreements.

text.p: Wing Tai Holdings Ltd said on Monday a wholly-owned subsidiary, Winshine Investment Pte Ltd, would enter two service agreements for residences.
It said in a statement it intended to tie up one agreement with Lanson Place Hospitality Management (Singapore) Pte Ltd, and another with Lanson Place Hotels And Residences (Neths).
Both companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of USI Holdings Ltd, in which Wing Tai holds a 20 percent stake.
The fees payable by Winshine Investment to the companies under the proposed 10-year agreements are approximately Singapore $5.5 million. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
